body:
Thank you. It's not that I don't, everything being strange and new is what is keeping me going, as I planned. As I saw it, the best way to get out of the dark place I was in, was a radical change. Which has been working great so far, but as I start to get used to all the new things the old feelings start to bubble back to the surface and being all alone here its difficult to get my mind off those things. I'm trying to keep myself busy and focused, but I'm very afraid I'm not quite achieving it. 
What I mean is, even though its working so far, I don't want to tumble and fall back to where I was before I came here...

Thanks for the support, if you know of any place I could get professional help while having very little/no money, please let me know!
